paragraphs: Eccovia became part of CaseWorthy in February 2025, and its site now presents the CaseWorthy platform. That platform handles case and program management for human services organizations, with coordinated care and outcome reporting.

Intake captures client data, settles eligibility in real time and connects people to services. The feature list runs from configurable workflows, encryption and role-based access to reporting, mobile access, client and partner portals, document management and case notes. Agencies can adapt forms, workflows and assessments themselves through a builder tool without writing code. An assistant called Cara is described as cutting documentation time and surfacing insights.

Users are nonprofits, government agencies and community organizations running programs such as aging services, behavioral health, homelessness and HMIS, workforce development and veterans services. The site claims more than 1,000 nonprofit organizations and local and state governments as users.
